snippet.title: The official trailer is live, and the Aisle Survive DEMO is AVAILABLE NOW #indiegame #retail
snippet.description:
The retail horror starts today 🛒
The official trailer is live, and the Aisle Survive DEMO is AVAILABLE NOW on Steam | GOG | EGS!
It is time to step into the boots of the ultimate survivor and see if you can handle Jade's absolute nightmare of a shift. 
Clock in, grab a stale breadstick, and test your survival skills before the system breaks you.

Play the free DEMO and wishlist Aisle Survive on Steam | GOG | EGS right now
Early Access launches on July 28, 2026!
